(()=>{var s="tracy-preview";var w=Object.freeze(["style","full"]),a="full";var d="tracy-preview";function i(t,n){try{window.parent.postMessage({channel:s,v:1,kind:t,mode:n},"*")}catch{}}function f(){let t=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel~="stylesheet"][href]')),n=0;for(let e of t){let r;try{r=new URL(e.href,document.baseURI)}catch{continue}if(r.origin!==window.location.origin)continue;r.searchParams.set(d,String(Date.now()));let o=e.cloneNode(!1);o.href=r.href;let c=()=>{e.parentNode!==null&&e.parentNode.removeChild(e)};o.addEventListener("load",c),o.addEventListener("error",c),e.parentNode.insertBefore(o,e.nextSibling),n+=1}return n}function p(t){if(t==="style"&&f()>0){i("applied","style");return}i("applied",a),window.location.reload()}function u(){window.parent!==window&&window.TracyPreviewStarted!==!0&&(window.TracyPreviewStarted=!0,window.addEventListener("message",t=>{let n=t.data;if(n===null||typeof n!="object")return;let e=n;e.channel!==s||e.v!==1||e.kind!=="refresh"||p(typeof e.mode=="string"?e.mode:a)}),i("ready"),window.addEventListener("pageshow",()=>i("ready")))}u();})();
